mapper.insert: insert into biz_metric_daily (store_id, metric_date, metric_code, metric_name, metric_value, dim_type, dim_value, create_time) values (#{storeId}, #{metricDate}, #{metricCode}, #{metricName}, #{metricValue}, #{dimType}, #{dimValue}, #{createTime}) on duplicate key update metric_name = values(metric_name), metric_value = values(metric_value), create_time = values(create_time)
